REST API for the Kubeflow Pipelines platform (v2beta1). Enables programmatic management of experiments, pipelines, pipeline versions, runs, and recurring jobs for machine learning workflows running on Kubernetes. Authentication depends on the Kubeflow distribution and is typically a bearer token or session cookie provided in request headers.
